build_lasso_regression: build a Lasso regression model with alpha=0.14 to fit sparse signals from synthetic sinusoidal data
build_ard_regression: build an ARDRegression Bayesian model to estimate coefficients with automatic relevance determination
build_elasticnet_regression: build an ElasticNet model combining L1 and L2 penalties with alpha=0.08 and l1_ratio=0.5
test_r2_score: test the R² score of Lasso, ARDRegression, and ElasticNet models on test data
split_train_test: split synthetic correlated feature data into train and test sets with time series ordering preserved
